name: ruflo-binas
description: Binas: the office floor as a living architectural model. A 3D cutaway office on its own blueprint where your Claude Code session and its subagents sit at desks, paper moves by pneumatic tube, lamps light when someone works, a flag rises when someone needs you, stamps land on done work, shipments leave through the dock, and the feed is a split-flap board. Fed by Claude Code hooks and Ruflo mission logs; any shift can be replayed.
